mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion IN ('failure', 'timed_out', 'startup_failure') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('queued', 'in_progress', 'requested', 'waiting', 'pending') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS running_count, AVG(CASE WHEN duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms > 0 THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms FROM workflow_run WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT CAST(started_at AS DATE) AS stat_day, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion IN ('failure', 'timed_out', 'startup_failure') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion IN ('cancelled', 'skipped', 'stale') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled_count, AVG(CASE WHEN duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms > 0 THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms FROM workflow_run WHERE conclusion IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY CAST(started_at AS DATE) ORDER BY stat_day ASC

SELECT workflow_name AS workflow_name, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion IN ('failure', 'timed_out', 'startup_failure') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed_count, AVG(CASE WHEN duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms > 0 THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms FROM workflow_run WHERE conclusion IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY workflow_name ORDER BY failed_count DESC, total DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT branch FROM ( SELECT branch, MAX(started_at) AS last_seen FROM workflow_run WHERE branch IS NOT NULL GROUP BY branch ) t ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT #{limit}
